name: frontier-headroom-oracle-routing-census-e1-v1
objective: Measure how much category headroom remains between a single practical ratio leader, an exact per-item oracle, an optional bounded-segment oracle, and the strongest presently feasible self-contained research ceiling before choosing another representation hypothesis.
claim_ceiling: Licensed training-only frontier and oracle-routing census. It is not an Axiom candidate, category win, validation or holdout result, product selector, independent reproduction, commercial benchmark across unlike hosts, or state-of-the-art evidence.

information_boundary.allowed: Only the 17 exact development items listed below may be opened after a clean execution lock binds every executable.
information_boundary.forbidden: Never open, stat, hash, sample, list, or derive statistics from any public-validation, consumed-validation, reserved-evaluation, private-holdout, or unlisted path.
information_boundary.private_holdout_status: sealed; identities and bytes absent from this plan
information_boundary.public_validation_status: sealed or consumed and categorically forbidden to E1
information_boundary.failure_policy: Any roster, digest, size, license, executable, command, host, receipt, schedule, exactness, accounting, or seal mismatch stops before the next codec invocation and cannot be converted into a partial result.

excluded_categories.general_binary_archive: No frozen licensed lineage-disjoint training corpus exists yet.
excluded_categories.incompressible_precompressed: The frozen development corpus is not yet constructed and byte-verified.
excluded_categories.image_audio_video: Already-compressed media requires a separate licensed corpus and objective; no ratio win is presumed.

codecs.artifact_path_policy: Each measured repetition uses a fresh nonexistent path ending exactly in .zpaq; retained or preexisting archives are forbidden because add appends.

measurement.artifact_accounting: Count the physical self-contained artifact file exactly. No payload-only, estimated-bit, dictionary-excluded, or side-file size is admissible.
measurement.host_comparability: Ratio comparisons require exact binary and item identities. Speed/RSS comparisons require the same otherwise-idle host, environment, process sampler, and repetition schedule; cross-host speeds are contextual only.
measurement.speed_tier_attainment: For each category and codec, each measured repetition aggregate compression or decompression throughput is sum(decoded source bytes) / sum(primary process wall nanoseconds) * 1000. The reported category scalar is the minimum repetition aggregate, never a mean or best item; peak RSS is the maximum direct-process wait4 peak across every item and repetition. A tier requires exact deterministic output and all three frozen compression, decompression, and RSS thresholds.
measurement.speed_tier_host_lock: AC versus battery, low-power mode, and thermal-pressure state are required telemetry. CPU governor, frequency, and turbo state are recorded when exposed and their platform-level absence alone does not refuse a tier. Refuse commercial speed-tier classification if required telemetry is unavailable, AC/battery or thermal state changes, or low-power mode is enabled; ratio evidence may remain admissible.

sample_ceiling.selection_reason: It is the strongest currently built, pinned, self-contained ceiling executable that fits the declared local 18 GiB RSS cap. paq8px v216 -11L failed its pinned local build; paq8px -12L and cmix v21 require a larger isolated host. E1 may not substitute a later codec after measurement begins; that requires E2.
sample_ceiling.construction: For item size N, budget B=floor(N*500/10000). Split B into five lengths differing by at most one byte. For stratum i in [0,4], offset=floor((N-length_i)*i/4). Reject overlap or out-of-range slices. Serialize AXE1S magic/version, category and item IDs, original size/SHA-256, five offset/length pairs, sampled payload length/SHA-256, then the exact slices in stratum order. The complete AXE1S container is the codec input and every container byte is counted.
sample_ceiling.binary_layout: All integers are unsigned little-endian. A string is u16 byte length plus canonical UTF-8 bytes and is limited to 65535 bytes. A digest is 32 raw SHA-256 bytes. AXE1S is magic[5]=AXE1S, version u8=1, category string, item string, original-size u64, original digest, stratum-count u8=5, then five offset u64 and length u64 pairs, sampled-payload-length u64, sampled-payload digest, then the exact sampled bytes in stratum order.
sample_ceiling.claim: The selected sample row is a feasible local ceiling diagnostic, not an absolute compression ceiling.

oracle_routing.binary_layout: All integers are unsigned little-endian. A string is u16 byte length plus canonical UTF-8 bytes and is limited to 65535 bytes. A digest is 32 raw SHA-256 bytes. AXE1O is magic[5]=AXE1O, version u8=1, category string, source-manifest digest, item-count u32, then per item: item string, codec string, decoded-size u64, decoded digest, artifact-size u64, artifact digest; complete artifact bytes follow in item-ID order. AXE1G is magic[5]=AXE1G, version u8=1, item string, original-size u64, original digest, segment-size u64, segment-count u32, then per consecutive segment: codec string, decoded-size u64, decoded digest, artifact-size u64, artifact digest; complete artifacts follow in segment order.
oracle_routing.per_item: For each category, choose the smallest exact complete whole-item artifact independently per item. Add AXE1O header/version, original aggregate size/SHA-256 manifest, item count, and for each item its ID, codec ID, decoded size/SHA-256, artifact size/SHA-256, then concatenate complete artifacts. Compare these total physical bytes with the smallest single-codec category container under identical framing.
oracle_routing.segment_trigger: Run the bounded-segment oracle only when per-item oracle gain is at least 0.50% or at least two items in the category have different winning codecs.
oracle_routing.segment_container: AXE1G magic/version, original item size/SHA-256, segment size/count; for each consecutive segment: codec ID, decoded length/SHA-256, payload length/SHA-256; then all complete independent segment artifacts. Count every header, table, digest, codec frame, and payload byte.
oracle_routing.whole_fallback_framing: The equally framed whole fallback is AXE1G with segment-count u32=1, segment-size equal to the full item size, and one complete whole-item codec artifact, then the same outer AXE1O category framing used by the segmented route.
oracle_routing.safe_upper_bound: For each item and category report min(equally framed best whole-item route, complete AXE1G segment route). This hindsight oracle is only an upper bound on a future bounded input-derived selector; it is not implementable selector evidence.
oracle_routing.no_expansion_reference: The equally framed best whole-item route remains an admissible fallback; report any framing delta and refuse a selector gain if its complete bytes exceed that reference.

calculations.best_single_practical: Minimum complete category bytes among kanzi-max, zstd-19-long, and xz-lzma2-9e when every item is exact and deterministic.
calculations.best_single_ratio: Minimum complete category bytes among all four codecs when every item is exact and deterministic.
calculations.segment_oracle_gain_basis_points: floor((equally_framed_best_whole_bytes - min(equally_framed_best_whole_bytes, complete_segment_oracle_bytes)) * 10000 / equally_framed_best_whole_bytes); when the optional segment stage is not triggered, its contribution is exactly 0 basis points.
calculations.headroom: Report all three integer basis-point values per category; negative raw deltas remain visible even when the safe upper bound clamps selector gain to zero.

decision_gates.advance_item_selector: Per-item oracle gain >=100 basis points in a category, with at least two winning codecs, all exact/deterministic, and no excluded bytes accessed.
decision_gates.advance_segment_selector: Net bounded-segment oracle gain >=200 basis points in a category after all AXE1G overhead, with positive net gain on at least two items and no item more than 50 basis points larger than its equally framed whole fallback.
decision_gates.advance_representation_research: Feasible sample ceiling is >=300 basis points smaller than best practical on at least two categories, or >=500 basis points on one category, with exact deterministic decodes and all side state counted.
decision_gates.reject_routing_lane: Reject selector-only work for a category when per-item gain <50 basis points and bounded-segment gain <100 basis points; an untriggered optional segment stage contributes exactly 0 basis points.
decision_gates.declare_practical_frontier_saturated: Diagnostic only when routing is rejected and feasible sample ceiling gap <100 basis points; this does not prove a global or theoretical frontier.
decision_gates.product_gate_unchanged: No E1 outcome is a product or Axiom win. Category candidates still require >=5% unseen complete-byte advantage plus frozen speed, memory, integrity, streaming, portability, holdout, and independent-reproduction gates.

result_schema.binding_rule: Every result path must be relative, normalized, unique, non-symlink, inside the immutable result directory, and paired with exact byte length and SHA-256. The verifier rejects missing, extra, duplicate, absolute, parent-traversal, symlink, unbound manifest, receipt, artifact, log, or side-state files.
result_schema.summary_rule: The verifier recomputes every item, category, sample, oracle, overhead, speed, RSS, tier, and decision value exclusively from schema-valid bound raw receipts and rejects any mismatch or unavailable value represented as zero.
result_schema.speed_summary_rule: For each category, codec, and repetition, join exactly one successful compress and one successful decompress process receipt per declared category item by item_id and repetition; require source_bytes to match the frozen item, map compress.wall_ns to encode_wall_ns and decompress.wall_ns to decode_wall_ns, reject missing or extra items and phases, then apply speed_tier_attainment.
